sloka: अहो नु बलवान् रामो महदस्त्रबलं च वै।यस्य विक्रममासाद्य राक्षसा निधनं गताः ।। ६.७२.१० ।।
transliteration: aho nu balavān rāmo mahadastrabalaṁ ca vai।yasya vikramamāsādya rākṣasā nidhanaṁ gatāḥ ।। 6.72.10 ।।

translations.english: "Rama's valour is great the strength of his missiles is great, and his valour is formidable. Rakshasas can't stand his range."
